sources.title: Vercel pricing and plan eligibility
sources.supports: Hobby is intended for personal non-commercial use. A later real commercial service needs an eligible plan.

sources.title: Vercel Hobby included usage
sources.supports: Current CPU, transfer and invocation allowances informed the small operating envelope.

sources.title: Vercel Function limits
sources.supports: Node.js Function duration, body-size and runtime constraints. Short requests and direct uploads avoid depending on large request payloads.

sources.title: Vercel cron usage
sources.supports: Hobby has daily cron frequency and imprecise timing. Contract deadlines and refunds must not rely on it.

sources.title: Supabase Free pricing
sources.supports: Free database, file and egress allowances, active project limit and inactivity pause. Checked on 22 October 2026.

sources.title: Supabase Storage access control
sources.supports: Storage access uses explicit policies. Backend credentials remain privileged; API authorization is still necessary.

sources.title: Supabase signed upload URL
sources.supports: Direct signed uploads bypass application payload limits. Current documented signed upload validity is two hours.

sources.title: Turso pricing
sources.supports: A free SQLite option was compared. Supabase was selected to combine the database and file storage in one service; no claim that Turso is unsuitable.

sources.title: NEAR API libraries
sources.supports: Official JavaScript library choices for RPC and transactions. Actual versions remain to be pinned at implementation.

sources.title: NEAR wallet login
sources.supports: Official wallet-connector documentation found through the API library page.

sources.title: Wallet Selector signing API
sources.supports: NEP-413 message signing interface, including browser-wallet redirect behavior. Application-specific nonce and session policies are our design.

sources.title: NEAR RPC providers
sources.supports: Current public testnet endpoint choices. Public endpoints carry rate and availability assumptions.

sources.title: NEAR CLI
sources.supports: Documented testnet faucet account-creation path; no user or contract account was created in this task.

sources.title: NEAR cross-contract calls
sources.supports: Independent receipts, callbacks and failure semantics inform withdrawal state and tests.

sources.title: NEAR access keys
sources.supports: Restricted keys and locked accounts. Key removal alone is insufficient if contract code can restore authority.

sources.title: Learning Equality about Kolibri
sources.supports: Existing open offline learning platform with custom resource support. SUNSET integration remains proposed and untested.

sources.title: UNICEF Learning Passport offline model
sources.supports: Existing hub and local network delivery model includes teacher/facilitator support. This is prior work, not a SUNSET partnership.

sources.title: Luanti server hosting documentation
sources.supports: Public multiplayer hosting has a distinct server and operating requirement; it is a later provider workload, not the Vercel control application.

sources.title: Official NEAR hackathon instructions
sources.supports: Event and submission dates and track/publication requirements. Homepage also describes a development period; pre-event code eligibility is not expressly resolved. See the dedicated timing research.

marketplace_discovery.decision: Select the user-named Supabase option for combined database and object storage under the zero-cost prototype constraint.

verification_scope: Official documentation supports platform capabilities and plan conditions. It does not validate the proposed application, cryptographic implementation, classroom deployment or educational outcomes.

failed_or_replaced_paths.result: Not retrievable; replaced with the official wallet-login page linked from the API documentation.

architecture_inferences: Reviewer-approved artifact and key binding is a disclosed trust model.
Buyer-assisted disclosure requires at least one authorized key holder retaining a usable backup.
A restricted managed release signer is a proposed implementation; its permission boundary must be tested.
The complete zero-cost core excludes mandatory paid inference and confidential execution.

rpc_status_checks.result: HTTP 403 from this environment; excluded as a configured fallback

rpc_check_limit: These status checks establish a response and claimed network identity at the recorded time. They are not a transaction, finality proof, latency benchmark or availability guarantee.
